title: Criminal Case Intake, FIR & Defence Strategy
description: Structured workflow for assessing criminal FIRs, mapping applicable statutes under new criminal laws (BNS/BNSS/BSA), and formulating defence strategy.

steps.title: FIR & Allegation Deconstruction
steps.objective: Analyze First Information Report (FIR) elements, informant statement, and penal sections.
steps.prompt_guidance: Deconstruct FIR into specific penal ingredients and verify whether cognizable/bailable.
steps.verification_gate: Determine whether incident occurred before or after 1 July 2024 to apply IPC vs BNS.

steps.title: Factual Timeline & Alibi Verification
steps.objective: Establish exact chronology of events, call detail records (CDR), and electronic alibi.
steps.prompt_guidance: Map accused timeline against alleged time and place of crime.
steps.verification_gate: Preserve electronic records immediately under Section 63 BSA certificate.

steps.title: Bail Petition & Procedural Safeguards
steps.objective: Draft anticipatory or regular bail application focusing on Section 479/482 BNSS safeguards.
steps.prompt_guidance: Formulate bail grounds emphasizing absence of flight risk, cooperation with investigation.
steps.expected_output: Comprehensive bail application with supporting affidavit.
steps.verification_gate: Verify compliance with Arnesh Kumar / Satender Kumar Antil arrest guidelines.
